name: Related Articles
summary: Passive fail-closed named list of one to three explicitly curated canonical Article Cards, with deterministic exclusions, intrinsic layout, and zero neutral runtime.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native thematic section named by its visible heading and omitted when the heading or article collection is empty.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible localized contextual heading whose target-unique id names the section.

anatomy.name: articles
anatomy.description: Native unordered list and intrinsic visual grid of one to three explicitly curated Article Card compositions.

anatomy.name: articleItem
anatomy.description: Native list item containing exactly one complete canonical Article Card composition.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One fluid intrinsic size whose grid adapts to the component's available inline space.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive projection of a complete target-authored recommendation collection with no root interaction or value state.

states.name: articleDestination
states.description: Each canonical Article Card owns its one native linked media/title destination, hover, and focus-visible behavior; L10 adds no activation state.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: A non-empty visible title and at least one complete Article Card are required. Missing either omits the complete root rather than emitting an unnamed or empty region.

behavior.name: namedSection
behavior.description: Neutral Web uses one native section named by the target-unique id of its visible contextual heading without a redundant explicit role.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: Article recommendations use native ul and li semantics in explicit curator order with no listbox, grid widget, feed, carousel, selection or roving focus model.

behavior.name: canonicalArticleCards
behavior.description: Every list item contains one complete canonical Article Card. Article Card retains article, heading, Link, media, Badge, metadata, focus and optional-content ownership.

behavior.name: curatedV1Source
behavior.description: The v1 target supplies one explicitly curated ordered set of at most three Article Cards, excludes the current article and duplicates, and preserves curator order. No tag fallback, inferred relevance, automatic ranking or personalization is used.

behavior.name: targetRecommendations
behavior.description: Targets own the curated records, source storage, routes, freshness, tracking, analytics, SEO, loading, error, refresh and no-result policy while enforcing the accepted current-article, duplicate and maximum-count rules.

behavior.name: articlePagePlacement
behavior.description: The article-page host places L10 after primary article content and before Comments. Author Card and Share Actions may be positioned around that boundary without changing L10.

behavior.name: intrinsicResponse
behavior.description: The visual grid responds to its own available inline size, uses logical geometry and preserves complete localized and unbroken content without viewport-derived component breakpoints.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: L10 owns no controlled or uncontrolled value, listener, observer, timer, request, cache, storage, live region, focus manager, measurement script, asset, animation or neutral JavaScript.

behavior.name: articleNavigationBoundary
behavior.description: Previous/Next Article Navigation is not registered in v1. The legacy .article-nav family is never L10 anatomy, API, state, fixture, behavior or adapter mapping and may become a future canonical component or explicit target composition.

properties.name: title
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete root when the trimmed visible heading is empty.
properties.description: Required non-empty localized contextual heading that visibly identifies and programmatically names the article collection.

properties.name: articles
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete root when no complete Article Card composition remains.
properties.description: One to three explicitly curated canonical Article Cards in curator order after removing the current article and duplicates; no tag fallback or personalized ranking is inferred.

accessibility: Require a non-empty visible contextual heading and at least one complete Article Card; omit invalid composition rather than expose an unnamed or empty region.
Associate the native section with its target-unique visible heading id through aria-labelledby without adding redundant role, aria-label or tabindex.
Use native ul and direct li semantics; do not add listbox, grid widget, feed, carousel, toolbar, selection, current-item or roving-tabindex behavior.

Preserve every canonical Article Card's native article summary, contextual heading rank, single required primary Link containing its contextual media and complete title, media alternative, Badge, metadata and complete content.
Keep native Link Tab, Enter, context-menu and modifier-key behavior. L10 owns no keyboard handling, root/item activation or live announcements.
Preserve complete localized headings and article titles, logical RTL flow, unbroken wrapping, 320 CSS-pixel reflow, effective 200-percent text and user text spacing without clamps.
Preserve canonical Article Card, Badge and Link contrast, focus-visible and forced-color behavior; L10 itself adds no motion and requires no reduced-motion exception.
Place L10 after primary article content and before Comments in article-page compositions; surrounding Author Card and Share Actions remain host-owned.
Do not include previous/next article navigation in this public property surface. No such component is registered in v1, and legacy .article-nav is never L10.

web.notes: Canonical Blog CSS and the shared Exhibit/Studio renderer implement a fail-closed named native list of canonical Article Cards, intrinsic layout and zero L10 runtime.

shopify.notes: A Theme Editor section maps Shopify's ordered article_list setting with limit three into canonical Article Cards, excludes the current article and duplicates, omits empty output, and exposes only contextual heading plus canonical child-card presentation settings. Article-template placement remains host-owned.
